name: guard
description: Safety hooks for every shell command Claude runs: no pushes to protected branches (main, master, staging, production), no deleting remote branches without asking, no env files, keys or secrets in a commit, a task-tracker reminder after a PR is opened or merged, and a check before finishing that edited code was tested. If a project ships its own copy at .claude/hooks/claude-guard.js, this one steps aside for that session.
